description.en: A curated library of crafted, copy-paste components for chat agents, thinking states, human-in-the-loop approvals, and AI-native interfaces.
description.zh: 面向 AI 原生界面的精选组件库：涵盖 Agent 聊天、思维链等待态、人机协同审批与上下文卡片等精雕细琢的交互组件。

content.en: Beautiful UI offers meticulously crafted copy-paste components specifically built for AI agents and generative UI workflows. Rather than generic buttons and inputs, it focuses on the unique UX challenges of modern AI software: real-time streaming text with blinking cursors, animated thinking & reasoning states, human-in-the-loop approval dialogs, collapsible tool execution chips, interactive diff tables, and prompt bars with rich context attachments.
content.zh: Beautiful UI 专为 AI Agent 及生成式界面打造，聚焦解决现代 AI 产品的独特交互诉求。区别于通用组件库，它集中提供了流式打字输出、思维链思考等待指示器、人机闭环审批卡片、工具调用执行气泡、可交互 Diff 对比表格以及带上下文附件的 Prompt 输入栏等深度定制组件，支持即拷即用。
